items.title: Berkshire posts steepest Q3 underwriting decline among major carriers
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway saw its third-quarter underwriting earnings drop 43% as GEICO claims costs and broader US casualty pressures affected major carrier results.

items.title: MSIG UK expands London Market operations into construction and marine cargo
items.summary: MSIG UK has added construction and marine cargo underwriting to its London Market operation with two senior appointments as part of its ongoing company paper build-out.

items.title: UK government expected to ease ZEV vehicle sales targets
items.summary: Plans to reduce the UK electric vehicle sales mandate will alleviate pressure on manufacturers but leave commercial motor insurers facing extended underwriting uncertainty.

items.title: Robinhood launches commission-free IPO Access in UK
items.summary: Trading platform Robinhood has launched IPO Access in the UK, enabling local investors to request shares in US listings at the offer price before public trading commences.

items.title: Miller predicts continued commercial insurance softening for European buyers at year-end
items.summary: London market broker Miller reports that Nordic, Iberian and wider European commercial insurance markets remain broadly soft ahead of the 1 January renewals.

items.title: AXA XL appoints Matt Helm to lead UK sports and entertainment team
items.summary: AXA XL has named Matt Helm as Head of Sports, Media and Entertainment for its UK and Lloyd’s business, alongside two internal appointments.
